rawQuotes.text: 接下来，请继续完成D18-D21的所有开发落地
D18 | Executable three-Agent delivery and repair | dsh tasks create working code and independently evaluate and repair a real failure
D19 | Methods and Skill sensors in execution | Selected methods and depth steps constrain real tasks and detect invalid results
D20 | Real run recovery and revision-bound evidence | Resume reconciles sessions and side effects; changed code invalidates affected evidence
D21 | Fresh-project and self-development acceptance | Independent evidence proves intake, design, environment, coding, repair, and customer delivery

goal: Complete D18-D21 by turning Story Delivery into a verifiable local runtime loop with method sensors, revision-bound recovery, and fresh-project self-development acceptance.
scenarios: A prepared project Story invokes Planner, Generator, and Evaluator through huntianling-runtime and records task, session, tool, artifact, and candidate revision references.
The selected Planner method records versioned Skill depth steps and sensors, and invalid method output is rejected with a run record.
A candidate file changed after checkpoint blocks resume while evaluation is pending, but a recorded failed evaluation can resume into repair.
Harness self-development acceptance starts a fresh project, produces a real candidate failure, repairs it, independently re-evaluates it, and only then shows customer delivery.
constraints: Do not weaken D16: manual, self-check, and demonstration evidence must not complete delivery.
Do not build a second model runtime; missing hosted live execution remains a visible gap.
Do not mark lint or hygiene pass while repository scripts are still probe blockers.
